name: manual_3ec84b
claim: Verify private-CA TLS on Windows with Python ssl or an explicit chain check, not curl.exe, and never weaken verification to compensate.

decisions.notes: curl.exe on Windows uses schannel revocation checks that cannot complete for a private CA, so it fails a valid chain; Python create_default_context(cafile) gave the true result.

rationale: curl.exe on Windows uses schannel revocation checks that cannot complete for a private CA, so it fails a valid chain; Python create_default_context(cafile) gave the true result.
